previous_assumption: Login/signup brute-force protection might already exist somewhere (a plugin, middleware, or documented known gap).
correction: Confirmed via full security audit (2026-09-11): there is no rate limiting anywhere in apps/api — no @fastify/rate-limit or equivalent dependency in package.json, no throttling on /auth/login or /auth/signup, and it isn't mentioned as a known/accepted gap in docs/. This is a real, currently-undocumented gap, not a previously-decided tradeoff. Everything else audited (IDOR/ownership checks across all 14 application services, SQL injection via sql-tagged templates, session/cookie handling, error-leakage in app.ts's setErrorHandler, cross-tenant list/aggregate filtering) came back clean.
